correctness.rationale: The complete domain is every odd a in Z_2 and every x in Z_2. For x odd and x=2t with t odd, the odd derivative factorization makes h_a an isometry of the relevant square-cosets. For x divisible by four, a unique canonical 2-adic square root yields an isometry g(s), giving the exact scaled-square third image. Congruence classes determine all overlaps; Haar measures and exact finite image counts follow. Uniform fibers follow from four odd-square roots and four additional modular lifts of the third branch. Independent exhaustive enumeration checked 261632 target-fiber cases, but the proof is unrestricted.

value.rationale: The degree-four unit-parameter family is the first quartic case in a classical Dickson sequence where permutation criteria leave all nonpermutation value information open. A complete all-parameter residue/fiber classification reveals three genuinely different positive 2-adic image densities, depending on unit square class. These are natural arithmetic invariants, not an arbitrary numerical slice, and enable testing/benchmarking more general Dickson value-set behavior.
